senses.gloss:
mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Old, ancient.
E.
प्र substituted for पुराण, and न aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Full, replete, filled.
m. (-णः)
1 Air inhaled, inspiration, breath.
2 Air, wind.
3 Life, vitality.
4 A vital organ or part.
5 Strength, power.
6 Myrrh.
7 Poetical talent or inspiration.
8 A name of BRAHMĀ.
9 A title of BRAHMĀ, the supreme spirit.
10 An aspiration in the articulation of letters.
m. plu. (-णाः)
The five vital airs or modes of inspiration and expiration collectively.
E.
प्र before अन to breathe, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bending, bowed, stooping, inclined.
2 Skilful, clever.
E.
प्र before णम to bow, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Bowing, bent, bowed.
E.
प्र before णम to bow down, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-राः-राः-रः)
Inclined, stooping, having the head or top bowed.
E.
प्रणत, and शिरस् the head.

f. (-तिः)
Salutation, reverence, obeisance, courtesy.
E.
प्र before णम to bow, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sounded, sounding.
E.
प्र before णद to sound, क्त aff.

mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्)
Bowing to, saluting with reverence or respect.
E.
प्र before णम to bow, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bending, bowing.
E.
प्र before णम to bow, क्त aff. with इट् inserted.

m. (-यः)
1 Affection, friendly or fond regard.
2 Acquaintance.
3 Asking, begging.
4 Affectionate solicitation.
5 Final emancipation or beatitude.
6 Trust, confidence.
7 Reverence, obeisance.
E.
प्र before णी to get, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं)
1 Devoid of passion or desire.
2 Disobedient, disagreeing.
3 Upright, straight, in rectitude.
4 Beloved.
E.
प्र away, णी to go, aff. ण्यत्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
1 Leading, conducting.
2 Dispensing.
3 Decreeing, awarding.
E.
प्र and णी to lead, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Rescuing, restoring to life.
E.
प्राण nom. v. caus. form, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Leading, conducting.
2 Dispensing, distributing.
3 Sentencing, awarding.
E.
प्र before णी to guide, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-नः)
Loverś quarrels.
E.
प्रणय, and मान indignation.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Attached to, loving.
E.
प्रणय, and पतुप् aff.

f. (-तिः)
Denial, refusal, non-compliance.
E.
प्रणय requiring, विहति rejecting.

mfn. (-यी-यिणी-यि)
1 Affectionate, kind.
2 Intimate, familiar.
m. (-यी)
A husband or lover.
f. (-यिणी)
A wife or mistress.
E.
प्रणय affection, इनि poss. aff.

n. (-नं)
Dancing.
E.
प्र before वृत to dance, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-वः)
The mystical name of the Deity, or syllable Om.
2 A small kind of drum or tabor.
E.
प्र before णु to praise, aff. अच्.

m. (-कः)
The mystical name of the Deity.
E.
प्रणव, and कन् added.

mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्)
1 Perishing, falling away.
2 Endeavouring to escape.
E.
प्र before नश to destroy, aff. शतृ.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Destroyed, lost, annihilated.
E.
प्र, and नष्ट destroyed.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Uncivil, uncomplaisant, rude.
E.
प्रनष्ट, and विनय decorum.

m. (-दः)
1 A loud noise, especially expressing approbation or delight, a huzza, a shout.
2 A low sound expressive of great pleasure, a murmur or sigh or rapture.
3 A disease of the ear, a noise or buzzing in the ear from thickening of the membranes, &c.
E.
प्र much, and नाद sound.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Who or what gives life.
n. (-दं)
1 Water.
2 Blood.
E.
प्राण life, and द who gives.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Fatal, deadly.
E.
प्राश, and अद what eats.

m. (-मः)
Respectful or reverential salutation, addressed especially to a Brahman or deity.
E.
प्र before णम to bow, aff. घञ्.

mf. (-लः-ली)
An issue from a pond, a drain, a watercourse.
E.
प्र before नल to bind, aff. घञ्; also with कन् added in the fem. form प्रणालिका (-का.)

m. (-शः)
Loss, destruction.
E.
प्र before णश to be destroyed, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Destroying.
E.
प्र before णश to be destroyed, causal v., घिणुन् aff.

mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नती-घ्नत्)
Preparing or threatening to strike.
E.
प्र and नि before हन to strike, aff. शतृ.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Kissed.
E.
प्र, णिसि to kiss, क्त aff.; also read प्रनिंसित.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be kissed, what may or ought to be kissed.
E.
प्र before णिशि to kiss, तव्य aff.; also read प्रनिंसितव्य.

n. (-नं)
1 Great effort, stress, energy.
2 Profound religious meditation.
3 Access, entrance.
E.
प्र and नि prefixed to धा to have, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-घिः)
1 A spy, a secret agent or emissary.
2 Asking, solicitation or request.
3 Care, attention.
4 A follower.
E.
प्र and नि before धा to have, aff. कि.

mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्)
Sounding deep or like thunder.
E.
प्र and नि before नद to sound, शतृ aff.

m. (-दः)
A deep sound, that of thunder or its like.
E.
प्र and नि before नद to sound, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Saluting, bowing or doing homage to.
E.
प्र and नि before पत to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bowed down in reverence, saluting.
E.
प्र and नि before पत to go, aff. क्त.

ind.
Having bowed down or in reverence, having saluted respectfully.
E.
प्र and नि before पत to go, ल्यप् aff.

m. (-तः)
Salutation, reverence, obeisance.
E.
प्र and नि before पत to go, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Delivered, entrusted, consigned.
2 Obtained, received, acquired.
3 Acknowledged, admitted.
4 Placed, fixed, deposited.
5 Prudent, advised, careful, wary.
6 Determined.
E.
प्र and नि before धा to have, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Favourable or good for living beings.
f. (-ता)
A shoe, a boot.
E.
प्राणि an animal, (man,) and हित suitable.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dressed (as food), cooked, &c.
2 Made, done, constructed.
3 Thrown, cast, sent.
4 Entered, approached.
5 Proper, fit.
6 Said, declared.
7 Delivered, given.
8 Decreed, sentenced, awarded.
9 Composed, written.
m. (-तः)
Fire, consecrated by prayers or mystical formulæ.
f. (-ता)
A vessel used at sacrifices, a sort of cup.
E.
प्र before णी to get, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Praised, celebrated.
E.
प्र before णु to praise, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-णुत् or णुद्)
Enjoining, directing, who or what commands or enjoins.
E.
प्र before णुद् to command, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Shaken, trembling.
2 Sent, dispatched.
E.
प्र before णुद to send, क्त aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Docile, submissive, agreeable.
E.
प्र before णी to lead, aff. यत्.

m. (-दः)
1 Directing, ordering.
2 Guiding, driving, (as horses.)
E.
प्र before णुद to send, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Ordered, directed.
2 Driven, guided.
E.
प्र before णुद to send, क्त aff.

m. (-कः)
1 An animal or sentient being.
2 Cloth, clothes.
3 A plant, (Celtis orientalis.)
E.
प्राण life, कन् aff.

n. (-र्म्म)
Vital action.
E.
प्राण, and कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्)
Living, breathing.
E.
प्राण nominal v. to live, शतृ aff.

m. (-गः)
Abandoning life, dying, suicide.
E.
प्राण, and त्याग relinquishment.

m. (-थः)
1 Air, wind.
2 A strong or powerful man.
3 A progenitor of mankind.
4 A place of pilgrimage.
E.
प्र before अन to breathe or be strong, Uṇādi aff. अथ.

n. (-णं)
Sustenance, supporting life.
E.
प्राण, and धारण upholding.

n. (-नं)
1 Life, living.
2 The throat.
E.
प्र before अन to live or breathe, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-थः)
A husband.
E.
प्राण life, and नाथ lord.

m. (-न्तः)
1 Air, wind.
2 A sort of collyrium: see रसाञ्जन.
f. (-न्ती)
1 Sneezing.
2 Hickup.
E.
प्र before अन to breathe, Uṇādi aff. भच्, fem. aff. ङीष्.

n. (-न्तं)
Death.
E.
प्राण, and अन्त end.

m. (-हः)
Life, existence.
E.
प्राण, and परिग्रह possession.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Saving life, when in imminent danger.
E.
प्राण, and प्रद who or what gives.

f. (-दा)
A medicinal plant, commonly Ṛddhi.
E.
प्राण life, प्रद what gives.

m. (-धः)
Extreme peril or distress, fear for life.
E.
प्राण, and बाध obstruction.

n. (-धं)
Any act injurious to life.
E.
प्राण, and आङ् before वाध to pain, अच aff.

m. (-स्वान्)
The ocean.
E.
प्राण life, भास्वत् the sun, the sun being produced or rising from the sea.

mfn. (-भृत्)
Living, sentient.
E.
प्राण, and भृत् who has.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Living, breathing, endowed with breath or life.
E.
प्राण, and मयट् aff.

m. (-षः)
One of the cases or investitures of the soul, the vital or organic case.
E.
प्राणमय, and कोष a sheath.

f. (-त्रा)
Support of life, subsistence.
E.
प्राण, and यात्रा proceeding.

m. (-यः)
Death, expenditure of life.
E.
प्राण, and व्यय expence.

m. (-मः)
1 A peculiar religious exercise: see पाणायाम.
2 Suspending the breath.
E.
प्राण breath, सम् before यम to restrain, aff. अञ्.

n. (-द्म)
The body.
E.
प्राण vital air, and सद्मन् abode.

f. (-मा)
A wife.
E.
प्राण life, समा equal to, same.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Destructive, taking away life.
E.
प्राण, and हर who or what takes.

n. (-कं)
Aconite.
E.
प्राण, and हारक what takes away.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Mortal, deadly.
E.
प्राण, and हारिन् what takes.

m. (-थः)
A husband.
E.
प्राण life, अधि over, नाथ lord.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Fatal, destructive of life.
2 Capital, (as punishment.)
n. (-कं)
Murder, assassination.
E.
प्राण, and अन्तिक final.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Deadly, fatal.
E.
प्राण, and अपहारिन् what takes away.

m. du. (-नौ)
1 The Aśvinī kumāras.
2 Two of the vital airs.
E.
प्राण, and अपान the air expelled by the anus.

m. (-मः)
Breathing in a peculiar way through the nostrils, during the mental recitation of the names or attributes of some deity; it is differently performed: the Vaidyas or followers of the Veda close the right nostril first with the thumb, and inhale breath through the left, then they close both nostrils, and finally open the right for exhalation: the followers of the Tantras close the left nostril first, and exhale also through it; these operations are severally called पुरक, कुम्भक, and रेचक.
E.
प्राण breath, आ before यम to restrain, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing for life.
E.
प्राण nom. v., desid. form, उ aff.

n. (-तं)
Cock fighting, ram fighting, setting animals to fight for wagers.
E.
प्राणि a living being, and द्यूत gaming.

mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि)
Living, breathing.
m. (-णी)
An animal, a sentient or living being.
E.
प्राण vital air, and इनि aff.

f. (-डा)
Cruelty to animals.
E.
प्राणिन्, and पीडा pain.

f. (-ता)
A mother.
E.
प्राणिन्, and मातृ mother.

f. (-सा)
Doing harm to any living creature.
E.
प्राणि, and हिंसा injury.

n. (-त्यं)
Debt.
E.
प्रणीत taken, यञ् aff.

m. (-शः)
A husband.
f. (-शा)
A wife.
E.
प्राण life, and ईश sovereign.

n. (-ङ्गं)
Any animal part or product, (as flesh, bone, milk, Ghee, &c.)
E.
प्राणिन, and अङ्ग a part.
